resize: Pillow NEAREST entire raw canvas, aspect-preserving fit within 72x98 with integer dimensions rounded
quantization: Pillow MEDIANCUT from opaque sampled RGB, 32 colors, no dithering
centering: integer floor offset; any odd spare pixel remains on bottom/right
limitation: Raw opaque alpha>=128 does not touch the outermost columns, but its side margins are less than one target logical pixel and NN sampling makes the 74x100 version touch the border. Whole silhouette completeness is not independently proven. Containment adds a transparent margin only; no content is painted or restored.
